'''SBI Life Insurance Company Limited'''<ref>{{Cite web|last=Insurance|first=SBI Life|title=SBI Life - Leading Life insurance Company in India|url=https://www.sbilife.co.in/en/about-us|access-date=2021-12-20|website=www.sbilife.co.in}}</ref> is an Indian [[life insurance]] company. It was started as a [[joint venture]] between [[State Bank of India]] (SBI) and French financial institution [[BNP Paribas]] [[Cardif]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Joshi |first1=Manish |title=Why SBI Life is winning the valuation game vs HDFC, ICICI Prudential {{!}} Stock Market News |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market/india-sbi-life-valuation-hdfc-life-insurance-company-icici-prudential-profit-life-insurance-stocks-ulips-11774425036955.html |website=mint |language=en |date=25 March 2026}}</ref>

In 2007, [[CRISIL]] Limited, a subsidiary of global rating agency [[Standard & Poor's]], gave the company a AAA/Stable/P1+ rating.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.livemint.com/2007/10/01000853/SBI-Life-Insurance-gets-top-ra.html|title=SBI Life Insurance gets top rating|date=1 October 2007|work=Mint}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/feeds/afx/2007/09/17/afx4123027.html|title=India's SBI Life Insurance rated 'AAA' on parental support – Crisil|date=2017-09-17|work=Forbes}}{{dead link|date=January 2022|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref> SBI Life is listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] And [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] (Stock Exchanges in India) and is a life insurance company in [[India]].<ref name="SBI Ref1" />

== Technology ==
In May 2026, SBI Life Insurance implemented an artificial intelligence-based underwriting system developed by Datamatics. The system, called TruAI Underwriting, is designed to automate the analysis of medical reports and assist in risk evaluation for complex insurance cases. <ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-05-27 |title=Datamatics shares rise as SBI Life implements its TruAI Underwriting Agentic AI solution - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/datamatics-share-price-sbi-life-implements-truai-underwriting-agentic-ai-solutions-implementation-ws-el-19914263.htm |access-date=2026-06-02 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}}</ref>

==History==
The company incorporated in [[Mumbai]] on 11 October 2000.<ref name="SBI Ref1" /> SBI Life started as a [[joint venture]] with BNP Cardif S.A in 2001.<ref name="SBI Ref1">{{cite news |title=SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/sbi-life-insuran-22045/information/company-history |access-date=30 April 2021 |publisher=Business Standard India}}</ref> In its initial stage its business was mainly from [[bancassurance]] channel.{{Citation needed|date=January 2026}}

SBI Life Insurance Company Limited is an Indian life insurance company. It was started as a joint venture between State Bank of India (SBI) and French financial institution BNP Paribas Cardif.
In 2007, CRISIL Limited, a subsidiary of global rating agency Standard & Poor's, gave the company a AAA/Stable/P1+ rating. SBI Life is listed on BSE And NSE (Stock Exchanges in India) and is a life insurance company in India.
